label: Chapter 13
title: HEALING WAS NEVER ABOUT FIXING YOURSELF

runs.text: PART 1 — THE DAY YOU STOP TRYING TO FIX YOURSELF
Ek point aata hai life mein jahan insaan itna thak jaata hai... ki usse sirf ek hi cheez chahiye hoti hai—
Aur wahi se healing ki journey usually shuru hoti hai.
Par dheere dheere ek ajeeb realization aata hai.
Shayad problem kabhi yeh thi hi nahi ki tum broken the.
Shayad problem sirf itni thi... ki tumne khud ko broken maanna shuru kar diya tha.
Aur dheere dheere humne maan liya... ki current version enough hi nahi hai.
Isliye har din ek project ban gaya.
Khud ko improve karne ka project.
Khud ko prove karne ka project.
Khud ko accept karne layak banane ka project.
Lekin ek sawaal kabhi poocha hi nahi gaya—
Agar tum already complete ho... toh phir tum itna bhaag kis cheez ke peeche rahe ho?
WHEN HEALING BECOMES ANOTHER EGO PROJECT
Kai log healing bhi waise hi karte hain... jaise competition karte hain.
Surface pe yeh growth lagti hai.
yeh sirf ego ka naya version hota hai.
Healing ka matlab perfect ban jana bhi nahi hota.
Healing ka matlab sirf itna hota hai...
ki tum apni humanity se ladna band kar dete ho.
Hum pain se bachne ki koshish karte hain.
Lekin shayad pain kabhi problem tha hi nahi.
Pain toh body aur mind ka language hai.
Wo sirf bol raha hota hai—
jab pain ke upar story ban jaati hai.
Pain kuch minute reh sakta tha.
Story usse saalon tak zinda rakhti hai.
pain ke meaning se suffer karne lagta hai.
Healing ka sabse beautiful moment wo nahi hota...
jab tum finally khush ho jaate ho.
jab tum dukhi hokar bhi khud se nafrat karna band kar dete ho.
Par tum uske against war nahi chhedte.
andar resistance kam hone lagta hai.
YOU DON'T HAVE TO EARN YOUR WORTH
Sabse dangerous belief shayad yeh hai—
"Mujhe pehle better banna padega... tab main
Lekin worth kabhi earn nahi hoti.
Worth existence ke saath aati hai.
tumhare thoughts se bhi bada hai.
ki tum dobara kabhi nahi roge.
Shayad healing ka matlab sirf itna tha...
ki jab yeh sab dobara hoga...
tab tum khud ka haath chhodoge nahi.
PART 2 — THE DAY YOU STOP TRYING TO FIX YOURSELF
Ek strange moment aata hai healing ke beech...
karte ho ki tum saalon se heal nahi ho rahe the.
Tum khud ko repair karne ki koshish kar rahe the.
Aur repair aur healing ek hi cheez nahi hote.
Bas kuch samjha nahi gaya tha.
Aur ye realization pehle comfort nahi deta.
Kyuki agar main broken nahi tha...
Toh phir itne saal main kis cheez ko theek karne ki koshish kar raha tha?
Mind ko projects pasand hote hain.
wo khud ko bana leta hai.
Surface pe ye growth lagti hai.
ye sirf self-rejection ka sophisticated version hoti hai.
"Jab tak main better nahi ban jata...
tab tak main enough nahi hoon."
Aur yahin healing quietly postpone hoti rehti hai.
present wale insaan ko continuously reject karta rehta hai.
Mind har cheez ko achievement bana deta hai.
Ab agar ek din anxiety aa gayi...
Jaise healing ka matlab kabhi pain feel na karna ho.
Healing ka matlab pain ka disappear hona nahi.
Pain ke saath relationship ka change hona hai.
Imagine karo tum paani ke andar ek ball ko force se dabaye hue ho.
utni hi force se wo upar aane ki koshish karegi.
Emotions bhi waise hi hote hain.
Jitna tum unhe push karte ho...
utna hi wo loudly wapas aate hain.
Inme se koi bhi permanent nahi hota.
Resistance unhe permanent jaisa feel karata hai.
Aur jis din tum unhe thoda sa space dete ho...
Wo naturally move karna shuru kar dete hain.
YOU DON'T HAVE TO WIN AGAINST YOUR MIND
Kai log healing ko war bana dete hain.
Par ek simple sa question hai...
Agar tum apne hi mind se lad rahe ho...
Isliye ye war kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
Aur har defeat personal lagti hai.
Shayad answer war jeetna nahi tha.
uski necessity kam hone lagti hai.
Par life dheere dheere ek aur definition sikhati hai.
Kabhi kabhi strongest insaan wo nahi hota...
Kyuki truth accept karne mein jitni courage lagti hai...
utni denial mein kabhi nahi lagti.
WHEN NOTHING NEEDS TO CHANGE FIRST
"Shayad pehle tumhara relation life ke saath change hoga...
phir baaki cheezein apni jagah par settle hone lagenge."
khud ko project ki tarah dekhna chhodne ka.
Khud ko problem samajhna chhodne ka.
sirf insaan ki tarah dekhne ka.
Shayad healing ka sabse bada sign ye nahi hota ki tum kabhi girte nahi.
Shayad sabse bada sign sirf itna hota hai...
ki girte waqt tum pehli baar khud ko dushman nahi banate.
PART 3 — THE QUIET RETURN TO LIFE
jab har din ek battle lagta tha.
ki ek din woh sirf baith jaata hai.
Na isliye ki usne give up kar diya.
kyunki uske paas ladne ki energy hi nahi bachti.
kai baar healing wahi se shuru hoti hai.
WHEN LIFE STOPS FEELING LIKE A PROBLEM
Ek din tum subah uthte ho.
Phone waise hi vibrate karta hai.
Log waise hi messages bhejte hain.
Life mein kuch extraordinary nahi hota.
Par andar kuch alag hota hai.
Pehle har cheez solve karni hoti thi.
Ab har cheez observe hone lagti hai.
Pehle har emotion ko naam dena zaroori lagta tha.
Ab kabhi kabhi emotion sirf feel hota hai...
Bas uske saath kuch der baithe rehte ho.
Healing ka sabse bada surprise yeh hota hai...
Koi enlightenment ka flash nahi aata.
chai peete waqt tum realize karte ho...
ki tum pichle dus minute se overthink nahi kar rahe the.
ki tum uska meaning nahi dhoondh rahe.
Ek dost ka message aata hai.
Aur tum uska tone analyse nahi karte.
Ye moments bahut chhote lagte hain.
real healing isi simplicity mein chhupi hoti hai.
YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE HAPPY ALL THE TIME
Ek aur illusion quietly tootne lagta hai.
Kuch din bina wajah aansu aa jayenge.
Kuch din purani yaadein wapas aa jayengi.
Tum turant yeh conclude nahi karoge—
ki emotions weather ki tarah hote hain.
Healing ke baad duniya nahi badalti.
Par tumhari nazar badal jaati hai.
Pehle tum har insaan se validation dhoondhte the.
Pehle tum prove karna chahte the...
Ab tum sirf present rehna chahte ho.
Aur interesting baat yeh hoti hai...
jo log sirf tumhare performance ke saath the...
woh dheere dheere door ho jaate hain.
Aur jo log tumhare existence ke saath the...
Sabse lambi journey duniya ghoomne ki nahi hoti.
Khud tak wapas aane ki hoti hai.
Aur jab tum finally wapas aate ho...
jise tum itne saal dhoondh rahe the...
woh kabhi gaya hi nahi tha.
thoughts ke shor ke neeche chup gaya tha.
Aur jab yeh sab dheere dheere halka hota hai...
toh tum koi naye insaan nahi bante.
ki shayad tum notice bhi na karo.
par woh mujhe lekar nahi chalta.
Main usse lekar chal leta hoon."
khud ke saath ek naya rishta.
Shayad healing ka sabse khoobsurat pal woh nahi hota...
jab tum bina kisi wajah ke...
andar se thoda halka mehsoos karte ho.
life ko theek karne ki jagah...
sirf jeena shuru kar dete ho.
PART 4 — WHEN YOU STOP TRYING TO BECOME SOMEONE ELSE
Jab insaan secretly ye believe karne lagta hai ki healing ka matlab hai—
Ek din uthna… aur phir kabhi hurt na hona.
Kabhi kisi ki yaad na aana.
Aur isi expectation ki wajah se…
healing shuru hone se pehle hi impossible lagne lagti hai.
Healing ka matlab pain ka disappear ho jaana nahi hota.
Pain ke saath tumhara relationship badal jaana.
THE PERSON YOU KEEP TRYING TO BECOME
Kitni baar tumne khud se kaha hoga—
Surface pe ye motivation lagta hai.
Par andar ek hidden message chhupa hota hai—
"Jo main abhi hoon... woh enough nahi."
Aur jab healing ki journey isi sentence se shuru hoti hai...
Toh har step pe tum khud se ladte rehte ho.
Jab tum continuously khud ko improve karne ki koshish karte ho...
Dheere dheere tum khud ko accept karna bhool jaate ho.
Har weakness project ban jaati hai.
Har insecurity fix karne layak machine defect lagti hai.
Aur phir life jeene se zyada...
Khud ko repair karne mein nikal jaati hai.
Ek second ke liye imagine karo...
Agar tumhare andar jo chal raha hai...
Usme se sab kuch immediately fix karna zaroori hi na ho?
Sabse pehli baar healing tab shuru hoti hai...
Jab tum apne emotion se bhaagna band kar dete ho.
Na usko forcefully positive banate ho.
"Haan... ye bhi experience ka part hai."
Jis emotion se tum itne saalon se bhaag rahe the...
Wahi emotion dheere dheere dissolve hona shuru kar deta hai.
Kyuki resistance hi uski energy thi.
YOU DON'T NEED TO WIN AGAINST YOURSELF
Par sabse dangerous competition wahi tha...
Jo humne khud ke against start kar diya.
Aur is race ka finish line kabhi aata hi nahi.
Kyuki future self hamesha future mein hi rehta hai.
Ek din shayad tum realize karoge...
Tumhare thoughts bhi kabhi kabhi overthink karte hain.
Emotions bhi kabhi heavy ho jaate hain.
Ab tum un sab se ladte nahi.
Ek ajeeb si peace aa jaati hai.
Jaise andar finally kisi ne weapons neeche rakh diye ho.
Healing ka opposite pain nahi hota.
Healing ka opposite hota hai — khud ke against chalti hui woh silent war... jo tumne kabhi consciously shuru bhi nahi ki thi.
